newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia wins $110 mln order in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Nokia wins $110 mln order in Thailand.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had signed an agreement with Advanced Info Services (AIS) of Thailand for turn-key expansions of GSM and NMT cellular networks.
"The frame agreement signed will cover...three years. The value of first year deliveries is estimated to be over $110 million," it said.
Nokia said it would deliver switches, base station controllers, base stations and network management systems to AIS.
The deal would also cover site survey and preparation, network planning, implementation, network optimisation and operation, and maintenance services.
Deliveries would start immediately, it said.
